bundle.shortDescription: A calm place for a professor's students, research, teaching and admin.
bundle.longDescription: Professor OS keeps track of your students, collaborators, projects, courses and tasks. Tell it what's going on in plain words; it organizes everything into pages, plans your day and follows researchers you care about. It runs on your computer and works through Claude Code or Codex.
